messages.subject: Could a small phone-reset pilot fit your audience?
messages.body:
Hi Colin,

I’m Aidan Torrence. Your work on digital wellbeing seems closely related to something I’m testing.

It’s a proposed 30-day phone reset: practical phone boundaries, a plan for recovered time, and weekly check-ins. The proposed price is $49; the interest stage takes no payment.

Would you consider sharing an optional invitation with adults who might find it useful, if the idea fits your work?

The concept and interest form: https://real-change-pilots-aidan-2026.aidantorrence.chatgpt.site/phone-reset?utm_source=digital_detox_coach&utm_medium=partner_email&utm_campaign=wave1

I’m not requesting any member lists or implying an endorsement. If it isn’t a fit, no problem.

Aidan
